title: OWECS Consultation Interface
text:
Welcome to the OWECS Consultation Interface.

Role assigned: Legal-Policy Advisor.

Location: Republic of Arcadia.

Project: Offshore Wind Energy in the Conan Sea.
You have been invited to support Arcadia's stakeholder consultation on the OWECS project.
This proposal could help transform Arcadia's energy future.
But it may also affect livelihoods, ecosystems, and regional shipping.

You get power. 
We lose our fishing grounds.
These wind farms could take away our catch, our livelihood, and the life our communities have built around this sea.

You call it clean energy. 
We see fragile ecosystems pushed closer to the edge.
These wind farms could disrupt migratory routes, damage marine habitats, and leave scars that last far beyond construction.

You redraw lines on a map. 
We face the delays at sea.
These wind farms could force longer routes, tighter corridors, and rising costs across the region.
Your task is not to defend one side too quickly.
Review the case materials, examine the project area, and consider what a balanced response could look like.
